newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on Tokyo, competition.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on Tokyo, competition.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices retained midday trends to close mixed, after tracking weak futures on the Tokyo market and adjusting to regional competition, traders said.
"It was quiet...no one was talking sales as far as I know," a trader said as he closed for the day.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted benchmark April RSS1 buyer at 306 cents ($1.24) a kg at the close, up one cent from Wednesday.
The board quoted April SMR20 buyer one cent down at 292.50 cents a kg.
